exact_rules.capacity: At each original signal-close, exact rational remaining quantity uses only actual fills strictly earlier than signal timestamp. Reserve min(1,available) per symbol. Equal-time close decisions precede old open fills and new entry; no future release borrowing.
exact_rules.daily_clock: Only complete UTC days assembled from six contiguous completed 4h bars.

entry.rule: Exact original native M1 squeeze setup and C63 ER/range eligibility, plus daily EMA21 eligibility OR strictly escaped range with close above nonfalling completed-daily SMA5; actual next 4h open subject to original expiry/floor/gap conditions.

exact_rules.hold: Before actual partial fill, original nonpositive 14-bar momentum exits; native time20 timeout is replaced by frozen TM management.
exact_rules.initial_risk: Original fixed setup floor close-confirmed, next actual open; no invented exchange resident stop or take-profit.
exact_rules.ordering: Original floor and safety priority; next actual open includes gaps; no additional stop/target/sizing overlays.
exact_rules.partial: At the third completed UTC day boundary strictly after entry, once only, positive close net after inherited cost requests 1/3 original lot at next actual open. Nonprofitable checkpoint does not rearm.
exact_rules.quantities: Normalized research quantities, same-symbol capacity <=1; strictly positive rational minimum. No exchange lot/min-notional model.
exact_rules.runner: Only actual partial fill activates remaining 2/3; close<=entry requests next-open residual exit. At completed UTC day close, close<SMA10 requests next-open exit. Original insufficient daily-history and same-decision D3 SMA10 safety remain.
exact_rules.source_control: Qullamaggie D3 profit partial / breakeven / SMA10 management, explicitly ZEL operationalized; not trader-return replication.
exact_rules.terminal: Unfinished lots remain open/censored with hypothetical-liquidation marks and costs; no forced terminal exit.
